# The Growth Union

> A strategy-led growth consultancy for MSMEs, startups and founders. Head office in Gurgaon, with an office in New Delhi (Saket). We serve clients in India, the UK, the US and worldwide.

## What we do
- Strategy and positioning, acquisition (ads, SEO, AEO), digital infrastructure, sales systems, legal and compliance, and hiring systems, under one roof.
- Monthly packages: Foundation, Growth and Custom, each scoped after a short call or a free audit. Three-month minimum on monthly plans. We quote in rupees for India and US dollars elsewhere.
- 14 service pages covering strategy, brand, PR, SEO and content, social media, paid ads, influencer marketing, CRM and automation, websites, e-commerce, sales support, sales management, recruitment and legal support. Choose a service and send a request.
- A free 30-minute growth audit, led by founder Neeraj Grover.
